description: Registration facts for a domain from its registry's RDAP server, located through the IANA bootstrap file: registrar name, IANA ID and abuse contact, created, updated and expiry dates, age and days to expiry, EPP status codes, transfer lock, nameservers, DNSSEC delegation flag, and the registry RDAP URL and terms link. No registrant contact data. Registries whose terms bar reuse (Nominet, CentralNic, Google Registry) are not queried. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, hostname, email address or URL. Scheme, path, port and credentials are stripped and IDNs are converted to punycode. IP addresses and private names are rejected. Facts describe the registrable domain (eTLD+1).

name: domain_whois
title: Domain registration facts (RDAP whois)
